question.worked_solution:
Recall that 

- ${max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is the maximum output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that maximum output occurs.

On the other hand,

- ${min}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is the minimum output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that minimum output occurs.

From the graph, 

- the highest point is at $(-1,2),$ so ${max}_{x\in T}g(x)=2$ and $\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in T}g(x)=-1,$ and

- the lowest point is at $(1,-4),$ so ${min}_{x\in T}g(x)=-4$ and $\operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{x\in T}g(x)=1.$
